name: Size Does Matter
source: The last opportunity from fate! The chance of a lifetime and an inevitable demise are coming your way. To avoid your death, you need to spend a hot night with the prophesied man until the next full moon comes. Are you ready to put some sizable effort?
translation: 命运的最后机会！一生难得的机会和不可避免的死亡正在向你走来。为了避免死亡，你需要与预言中的人一起度过一个炎热的夜晚，直到下一个满月到来。你准备好付出相当大的努力了吗？
